# Supporting Information — tables (v4, generated by code/experiments/atlas/v4/make_si_v4.py)

## Flow of people and cohorts
Healthy adult cohorts with >= 20 controls in curatedMetagenomicData: 62 listed; data available for 56.
De-duplication removed 119 samples and dropped ThomasAM_2019_c (Table S7).
Full set after de-duplication: 8,160 people, 55 cohorts, 27 countries (12 non-westernised).
Strict set (primary): 6,525 people, 36 cohorts, 20 countries (9 non-westernised).
Per classifier, cohorts used to train that classifier are excluded: strict 32–35 populations.
